title: 由点或乘积关系确定反比例表达式
stem:
如图，在平面直角坐标系中，矩形\(ABCO\)的两边\(OA\)，\(OC\)落在坐标轴上，反比例函数\(y=\frac { k } { x }\)的图象分别交\(BC\)，\(OB\)于点\(D\)，点\(E\)，且\(\frac { BD } { CD }=\frac { 5 } { 4 }\)，若\(S_{ \vartriangle AOE } =12\)，则\(k\)的值为_____________．
〔图1〕
given_solution:
【分析】过点\(E\) 作\(EH\bot OA\) 与点\(H\)，连接\(OD\)可以设\(BD=5m\) ，\(CD=4m\) ，\(OC=n\)，求出\(S_{ \vartriangle COD } =S_{ \vartriangle EOH } =2mn\) ，\(S_{ \vartriangle BAO } =S_{ \vartriangle BCO } =\frac { 9 } { 2 }mn\)再根据\(EH\parallel AB\)得出\(\vartriangle EOH\backsim \vartriangle BOA\)进而求出\(\frac { OE } { OB }=\frac { 2 } { 3 }\)，在根据\(\frac { S_{ \vartriangle AEO } } { S_{ \vartriangle ABO } }=\frac { OE } { OB }\)求出\(mn=4\)，在根据\(S_{ \vartriangle COD } =2mn=\frac { \left | { k } \right | } { 2 }\)可以解答出答案．
【详解】如图，连接\(OD\)过点\(E\) 作\(EH\bot OA\) 与点\(H\)设\(BD=5m\) ，\(CD=4m\) ，\(OC=n\) 则\(BC=9m\)
〔图2〕
\(\because S_{ \vartriangle COD } =\frac { 1 } { 2 }OC\cdot CD\)
\(\therefore S_{ \vartriangle COD } =\frac { 1 } { 2 }n\cdot 4m=2mn\)
\(\because S_{ \vartriangle EOH } =S_{ \vartriangle COD }\)
\(\therefore S_{ \vartriangle EOH } =2mn\)
\(\because S_{ \vartriangle BCO } =\frac { 1 } { 2 }BC\cdot OC\)
\(\therefore S_{ \vartriangle BCO } =\frac { 1 } { 2 }\times 9m\cdot n=\frac { 9 } { 2 }mn\)
\(\therefore S_{ \vartriangle BAO } =S_{ \vartriangle BCO } =\frac { 9 } { 2 }mn\)
\(\because EH\parallel AB\)
\(\therefore \vartriangle EOH\backsim \vartriangle BOA\)
\(\therefore \frac { S_{ \vartriangle EOH } } { S_{ \vartriangle BOA } }=\left ( { \frac { OE } { OB } } \right ) ^ { 2 } =\frac { 2mn } { \frac { 9 } { 2 }mn }=\frac { 4 } { 9 }\)
\(\therefore \frac { OE } { OB }=\frac { 2 } { 3 }\)
\(\because \frac { S_{ \vartriangle AEO } } { S_{ \vartriangle ABO } }=\frac { OE } { OB }\) （同高）
\(\therefore \frac { 12 } { S_{ \vartriangle ABO } }=\frac { 2 } { 3 }\)
\(\therefore S_{ \vartriangle ABO } =18\)
\(\therefore \frac { 9 } { 2 }mn=18\)
\(\therefore mn=4\)
\(\because S_{ \vartriangle COD } =2mn=\frac { \left | { k } \right | } { 2 }\)
\(\therefore \left | { k } \right |=16\)
又\(k < 0\)
\(\therefore k=-16\)
故答案为\(-16\)．
【点睛】本题考查反比例函数、相似三角形的判定和性质，熟练掌握相似三角形的判定和性质是解题的关键．
